tools.name: list_contact_lists
tools.title: List contact lists
tools.description: List your AceMail contact lists (imported CSVs / sheets) with contact counts.

tools.name: list_contacts
tools.title: List contacts
tools.description: Read contacts in a contact list, including all custom fields (CSV columns). Paginate with offset.

tools.name: update_contact_fields
tools.title: Update contact fields
tools.description: Write values to contacts: set first_name/last_name/company or create/update custom fields (new columns usable as {{field}} in templates). Up to 200 contacts per call.

fields.description: Field name to value. Standard: first_name, last_name, company; anything else becomes a custom field.

tools.name: create_contact_list
tools.title: Create contact list
tools.description: Create a new empty contact list.

tools.name: add_contacts
tools.title: Add contacts
tools.description: Add up to 500 contacts to a list. Emails already in the list are skipped. Extra fields become custom fields usable as {{field}}.

tools.name: delete_contacts
tools.title: Delete contacts
tools.description: Permanently remove up to 200 contacts by ID. Sent email history is kept; their unsent queued emails are cancelled. Confirm with the user first.

tools.name: list_templates
tools.title: List templates
tools.description: List email templates. Set include_body to also return subject and HTML body.

tools.name: save_template
tools.title: Create or update template
tools.description: Create a template (omit template_id) or update one. Body is HTML; use {{field}} variables and {a|b} spintax. Returns a spam score.

tools.name: list_campaigns
tools.title: List campaigns
tools.description: List campaigns with status, list, schedule and steps (template + delay).

tools.name: get_campaign_stats
tools.title: Campaign stats
tools.description: Email counts by status (queued, sent, opened, replied, bounced, failed, cancelled) for one campaign, or all email if campaign_id is omitted.

tools.name: list_inbox
tools.title: List inbox replies
tools.description: Read replies received from contacts (newest first), with snippet and auto-reply flag.

tools.name: list_outbox
tools.title: List sent and queued emails
tools.description: Read email send log (queued, sent, opened, replied, bounced, failed) with recipient and timestamps.

tools.name: manage_do_not_contact
tools.title: Do-not-contact list
tools.description: List the do-not-contact list, or add emails to it (they will never be emailed by any campaign).

tools.name: get_contact_detail
tools.title: Contact detail
tools.description: One contact's profile (name, company, title, phone, LinkedIn, custom fields) with their email history and LinkedIn steps.

tools.name: update_contact_profile
tools.title: Update contact profile
tools.description: Set a contact's job title, phone or LinkedIn profile link (needed for LinkedIn sequences).

tools.name: list_linkedin_sequences
tools.title: List LinkedIn sequences
tools.description: List LinkedIn sequences with mode (assisted/manual or runner/automated), status, daily limits, steps and task counts.

tools.name: set_linkedin_sequence_status
tools.title: Start or pause LinkedIn sequence
tools.description: Start (running) or pause a LinkedIn sequence. Starting schedules steps for contacts with a LinkedIn profile link.

tools.name: list_linkedin_tasks
tools.title: List LinkedIn tasks
tools.description: List LinkedIn steps (visit, connect, message, follow, endorse) with contact, profile link and personalized message. Defaults to pending.

tools.name: complete_linkedin_task
tools.title: Mark LinkedIn task
tools.description: Mark a LinkedIn task done, skipped or failed after the user did it manually. Done schedules the contact's next step.

tools.name: mark_linkedin_replied
tools.title: Contact replied on LinkedIn
tools.description: Stop a contact's remaining LinkedIn steps and queued emails because they replied on LinkedIn.

tools.name: get_linkedin_activity
tools.title: LinkedIn activity
tools.description: Totals of LinkedIn actions (visits, connects, messages, follows, replies, failures) over the last N days, plus pending count.

tools.name: list_crm_stages
tools.title: List CRM Pipeline Stages
tools.description: List all stages in the CRM sales funnel/pipeline, with their deal counts, colors, positions, and won/lost flags.

tools.name: manage_crm_stages
tools.title: Manage CRM Pipeline Stages
tools.description: Customize the sales funnel stages: add a new stage, rename or change color of a stage, reorder stages, or delete a stage (optionally migrating deals to another stage). Accepts stage UUID or stage name.

id.description: Stage ID or exact/partial stage name for rename or delete

name.description: New stage name (when adding or renaming)

color.description: Stage color (slate, blue, emerald, amber, violet, rose, orange, cyan, indigo, red, green)

is_won.description: Whether this stage marks closed won deals

is_lost.description: Whether this stage marks closed lost deals

stage_ids.description: Ordered array of stage IDs or names for reordering

migrate_to_stage_id.description: Destination stage ID or name to move deals to when deleting a stage

tools.name: list_crm_deals
tools.title: List CRM Deals
tools.description: List deals in the pipeline with their stages, assigned contacts, close dates, and values.

tools.name: manage_crm_deals
tools.title: Manage CRM Deals
tools.description: Create a deal, move a deal to another stage, update deal value/title/expected close, or delete a deal.

contact_id.description: Contact ID or contact email/name for new deal

stage_id.description: Target stage ID or stage name

tools.name: list_crm_leads
tools.title: List CRM Leads
tools.description: List inbound/outbound leads with their status, source, value, and contact details.

tools.name: manage_crm_leads
tools.title: Manage CRM Leads
tools.description: Create, update, delete, or convert a lead into an active sales pipeline deal.

source.description: Source: website, referral, cold_outreach, social, etc.

contact_id.description: Existing contact ID for conversion or linking

stage_id.description: Target pipeline stage ID for deal conversion

tools.name: list_crm_call_logs
tools.title: List CRM Call Logs
tools.description: List phone call history, talk time durations, summaries, and outcomes with linked contacts/deals/leads.

tools.name: manage_crm_call_logs
tools.title: Manage CRM Call Logs
tools.description: Log a completed or missed call, update call notes, or delete a call record.

tools.name: list_crm_tasks
tools.title: List CRM Tasks
tools.description: List to-dos, priorities (low/medium/high/urgent), and due dates for contacts, deals, or leads.

tools.name: manage_crm_tasks
tools.title: Manage CRM Tasks
tools.description: Create a task, mark a task completed, update priority or due date, or delete a task.

id.description: Task ID for update or delete

tools.name: list_crm_activities
tools.title: List CRM Activities
tools.description: List scheduled activities (calls, meetings, lunches, tasks, emails) with their status, schedule time, and linked contacts.

tools.name: manage_crm_activities
tools.title: Manage CRM Activities
tools.description: Schedule a new activity (call, meeting, lunch, task), mark an activity done, update schedule/notes, or delete an activity.

tools.name: list_crm_organizations
tools.title: List CRM Organizations
tools.description: List company/organization accounts with industry, employee count, and website.

tools.name: manage_crm_organizations
tools.title: Manage CRM Organizations
tools.description: Create, update, or delete organization/company accounts.

tools.name: list_crm_products
tools.title: List CRM Products
tools.description: List products and services in the CRM catalog with their pricing and SKU.

tools.name: manage_crm_products
tools.title: Manage CRM Products
tools.description: Add, update, or remove products and services from the price catalog.

tools.name: list_crm_quotes
tools.title: List CRM Quotes
tools.description: List generated price quotes with status (draft/sent/accepted/rejected), client info, and valid dates.

tools.name: manage_crm_quotes
tools.title: Manage CRM Quotes
tools.description: Create a quote, add/remove line items from a quote, update status (draft/sent/accepted/rejected), or delete a quote.

item_name.description: Item name when adding a line item

product_id.description: Product ID from catalog to link item
